resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NGS listing for FG1910 has two rows for the same station: one coded XX (surface mark reported destroyed) and one coded NN (no geodetic control). Not resolved, and the listing gives no date. The story reports both codes.

sources.title: Datasheet listing for PID FG1910 (BOSTON LOT)

notes_for_editor: Identity, the 1940 notice and the 1971 description (85 ft) are well sourced. The record's height_m 25.9 matches 85 ft, so no correction. Removal date and reason not found: the directory says only 'Removed', and the NGS listing codes the surface mark as destroyed with no date. Built date and builder not found. Access unknown; the 1971 driving directions were not repeated because they are old. Searches for a dated removal of the Muddy Gap tower returned nothing usable.
